messages:
nicholas_sales: quick sync  Crestline Finance wants a 2-week technical POC next month. Key asks: SAML SSO (Okta + OneLogin), SCIM bulk import (~25k users) + near-real-time deltas for group updates, RBAC with delegated admin scopes (per-division), cross-brand domain verification (5 brands), audit logs retained 18 months, and ability to export immutable logs to customer S3. They also want a clear migration path from Hosted to Dedicated and an estimate of dedicated baseline cost. can we map blockers and what we need to prepare?
priya_se: can they do DNS TXT proofing for all brands? also need to confirm whether they require SHA-256 signatures and want audiences/assertion encryption. For SCIM: are they ok with staged imports (csv -> bulk API) or expect an AD connector?
sam_security: security checklist: BYOK KMS integration (customer-managed keys), support for HSM-backed keys for signing (if required), SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence, retention + WORM support for logs, and SAML assertion lifetime constraints. i'll add a short questionnaire; recommend we ask about required regional data residency (eu/us) early.
jamie_reliability: technical constraints: bulk import throughput we can handle but for 25k accounts recommend chunking to 500-1000 users per job with concurrency set to 6. SCIM delta should be near realtime for group changes; we throttle to 200 ops/s by default but can bump for Dedicated. note: delegated admin scoped to org unit is supported via custom role templates; current limit is 50 custom roles per org. if they need per-division templates >50 we should flag for eng review.
olivia_se: provisioning plan: propose POC flow -> 1) DNS TXT proof for one brand (automated) + email fallback for others, 2) bulk CSV import to demo user parity, 3) enable SCIM deltas and show group sync examples, 4) validate delegated admin flows. i'll prepare a SAML attribute mapping example (mail, uid, groups, division).
nicholas_sales: they asked about time to provision Dedicated dev slot for integration testing and whether we can include an SLA for POC uptime.
infra_bot: Provision request accepted: dedicated-dev-crestline-01 (equiv g5.xlarge) scheduled, available 2024-07-01T08:00:00Z - 2024-07-14T20:00:00Z. ticket #PS-7892.
priya_se: for pricing: two models to show in the POC deck: hostedusage-based with POC spend cap + recommended quotas, and Dedicated monthly commit with dev discount for initial 3 months. ill run a quick cost model but need expected token/embedding volumes and average request lengths. tagging @nicholas_sales to collect. :moneybag:
sam_security: one more ask: do they require SAML artifact resolution or HTTP-POST only? different partners ask for artifact; we should surface it now.
nicholas_sales: good point. i'll confirm artifact vs post. thanks all  we'll reconvene after i get the answers and ill upload Crestline's security questionnaire responses to the shared drive.
